Name: Pontius Pilate
Summary: Pontius Pilate was the Roman governor who tried Jesus. He repeatedly declared he found no fault in Him, yet handed Him over to be crucified to satisfy the crowd, washing his hands of the verdict.
KeyStory: Pilate asked, What is truth?, then gave the order he did not believe in.
LifeLesson: Knowing the right verdict is not the same as giving it. Pilate warns us against trading conscience for quiet.
